summary: Blockout correctly captures the macro form: three flat glass-like planes forming an inverted-U (one horizontal top slab, two vertical end panels), with no apron, stretcher, leg or drawer added — matching the primary mustMatch constraint. Overall width/height/depth proportions (≈1.4 x 0.72 x 0.65 m) read correctly against the photo in the three-quarter, front, side and top views, and the side view shows the top slab overhanging the panel depth as required. Panel inset along the width axis (0.035 m) is too subtle to verify visually at this stage but nothing contradicts it. Flat, uniform colour is expected and correct for a blockout pass — the missing gradient tint, brackets, foot pads and edge banding are form/material/surface concerns for later passes, not defects here. Camera framing (yaw/pitch/distance) in the left render reasonably reproduces the reference three-quarter angle. No structural defects (floating parts, wrong primitive, misplaced component) were found at this pass's resolution, so it is ready to proceed to the structural/form pass.
